name: tp-hr-ios
description: Capacitor wrapper around hr.tp-asset.com for Ad Hoc distribution

scripts.build:sim: cap sync ios && xcodebuild -project ios/App/App.xcodeproj -scheme App -sdk iphonesimulator -configuration Debug -destination 'generic/platform=iOS Simulator' CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO build
scripts.archive: cap sync ios && xcodebuild -project ios/App/App.xcodeproj -scheme App -configuration Release -archivePath build/App.xcarchive archive
